game.title: Carolina Panthers at Green Bay Packers

lede: Green Bay Packers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Green Bay Packers −3.5 with a fair total of 45.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Green Bay Packers pass offence vs Carolina Panthers pass defence, which sits +0.108 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Carolina Panthers and Green Bay Packers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
